parse_test_log: parse an LLVM test log file and return a dictionary of test results with states and timings
diffResults_regressions: diff two parsed test result dictionaries and print regressions, new passes, and removed tests
run_findRegressions_cli: run the findRegressions-simple script with old and new LLVM test log files as arguments
parse_compile_exec_results: parse TEST-PASS, TEST-FAIL, and RESULT lines from LLVM test output into structured data
detect_time_regresions: detect execution or compilation time regressions exceeding 5% threshold between two test runs
